blocks.text: Rental Property Cleanout Services in Toronto & the GTA — Clear the Old Tenancy, Reset the Property

c: A rental property can change hands quickly. One tenant moves out, furniture gets left behind, the basement needs clearing, the garage is full, and suddenly the property that looked ready for its next chapter needs a complete reset. Live Junk Free handles rental property cleanouts across Toronto and the GTA, removing unwanted furniture, appliances, household belongings, garbage, and accumulated junk so landlords and property managers can get the space ready for what comes next.

blocks.text: From Tenant Move-Outs to Property Turnovers — We Clear What Gets Left Behind

Rental cleanouts are rarely limited to a few unwanted items. A tenant may leave behind furniture, mattresses, appliances, boxes, kitchen items, garbage, or belongings throughout the unit. We can clear apartments, houses, basements, garages, storage areas, and other accessible parts of the rental property in one coordinated visit, helping owners prepare the space for cleaning, repairs, renovation, or the next tenant.

items.title: The property gets assessed — then the cleanout gets priced

blocks.text: Every rental turnover is different. One unit may need a few pieces of furniture removed, while another may require a full cleanout after a long tenancy or eviction. We assess the actual volume and type of material before providing a quote, so landlords and property managers know what the complete removal will cost before the work begins.

items.title: One quote for the outgoing tenancy

blocks.text: Once a tenant leaves, the list can grow quickly — sofa, mattress, broken appliances, boxes, kitchen items, basement clutter, and garage junk. Instead of arranging separate pickups for every category, we can assess the entire property and provide one straightforward quote for the items that need to go.

items.title: From abandoned belongings to an empty property

blocks.text: After you approve the quote, our crew handles the lifting, carrying, loading, hauling, and disposal. We can remove unwanted furniture, appliances, mattresses, household items, boxes, and general non-hazardous junk from the rental property, leaving the space ready for the next stage of turnover.

items.title: Cleanouts that work around the property

blocks.text: Rental properties can include apartments, townhomes, detached houses, basements, garages, storage rooms, and outdoor areas. Our crew works through accessible rooms and spaces carefully, handling bulky items and stairs when required and dismantling suitable oversized pieces when necessary for removal.

A vacant rental can mean lost income when cleaning and repairs cannot begin. We help property owners and managers move the cleanout forward so the next contractor, cleaner, renovator, or tenant does not have to wait for unwanted belongings to disappear. Service is available seven days a week from 6AM to 11PM, with same-day appointments available when scheduling allows.

There is no need to separate furniture removal, appliance removal, box removal, and general junk hauling into different jobs when everything is ready at once. Combining the work into one rental property cleanout can save time and simplify turnover for landlords, property managers, real estate professionals, and homeowners preparing an investment property for its next occupant.
Rental Property Cleanout Pricing in Toronto & the GTA
Volume-Based, Straightforward, and Built for Property Turnovers

Rental property cleanout costs depend on the amount of junk, the type of materials being removed, the property size, and the work required to access everything. A small apartment turnover will have different requirements from a full house, basement, and garage cleanout. Live Junk Free provides a free quote before starting, so property owners and managers know the expected removal cost upfront.
Four Steps From Tenant Move-Out to Property Reset
A simple process for landlords, property managers, and rental property owners:

items.title: 1. Book the Truck
text: Call +1 647 922 5865 or schedule your rental property cleanout online. Live Junk Free serves Toronto and the GTA seven days a week from 6AM to 11PM, with same-day service available when scheduling allows.

items.title: 2. Show Us What Was Left Behind
text: Point out the furniture, appliances, boxes, mattresses, garbage, basement items, garage clutter, or other unwanted belongings that need to be removed. We'll assess the load and provide a clear quote before beginning.

items.title: 3. We Clear the Property
text: Once approved, our crew handles the heavy lifting, carrying, loading, and hauling. We can work through accessible apartments, houses, basements, garages, storage areas, and other parts of the rental property.

items.title: 4. Sorted and Handled Responsibly
text: Once the unwanted items are removed, we tidy the immediate work area. Reusable items may be directed toward donation or reuse, while suitable recyclable materials are separated whenever practical. Non-reusable items are handled through appropriate disposal channels.

blocks.text: Everything a Rental Tenant Leaves Behind — Furniture, Appliances and the Forgotten Extras
Whether you're dealing with a routine move-out or a property that needs a much bigger reset:

a: Sofas, sectionals, mattresses, bed frames, dressers, dining tables, chairs, desks, and other furniture are common leftovers after a tenant moves out. We can remove unwanted furniture from rental apartments, condos, townhomes, and houses so the property can be prepared for its next occupant.

Old refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, dishwashers, ovens, stoves, and other unwanted appliances can take up valuable space between tenancies. Our crew handles the heavy lifting and removal from accessible kitchens, laundry rooms, basements, garages, and other areas of the property.

Some turnovers involve much more than a few abandoned items. We can clear multiple rooms, basements, garages, storage spaces, and other accessible areas when a rental property needs a more complete cleanout after a move-out, eviction, renovation, or long tenancy.

From boxes and household clutter to exercise equipment, patio furniture, yard items, broken belongings, and oversized junk, rental properties can accumulate a surprising amount of material. We handle the lifting, loading, and hauling so landlords and property managers can focus on getting the property ready for its next use.

Frequently Asked Questions About Rental Property Cleanout Services in Toronto & the GTA

items.q: Q: How much does a rental property cleanout cost?
a: The cost depends on the amount and type of junk, the size of the property, and how much material needs to be removed. A small apartment move-out will typically require less removal than a house with a basement and garage full of abandoned belongings. Live Junk Free provides a free quote before starting, so landlords and property managers can understand the cost upfront.

items.q: Q: Can you clean out a rental property after a tenant moves out?
a: Yes. We can remove unwanted furniture, appliances, mattresses, boxes, household belongings, garbage, and other non-hazardous junk left behind after a tenant moves out. We can handle everything from a few abandoned items to a larger whole-property cleanout.

items.q: Q: Do you handle eviction cleanouts?
a: Yes. Rental property cleanouts can be arranged after an eviction when unwanted belongings remain in the unit. Our crew can clear accessible rooms and other areas of the property, including furniture, appliances, boxes, and general household junk.

items.q: Q: Can you clean out the basement and garage too?
a: Yes. A rental property cleanout does not have to stop at the main living area. We can remove unwanted items from accessible basements, garages, storage rooms, patios, and other areas when they are included in the cleanout.

items.q: Q: Can landlords or property managers book recurring cleanouts?
a: Yes. Property owners and managers who regularly handle tenant turnovers can arrange junk removal around their rental schedules. Coordinating furniture, appliance, and general junk removal through one service can make recurring property turnovers easier to manage.
